news.titleEn: Markets live: ASX down as US-Iran tensions flare and oil hits seven-week high
news.conclusionEn: Renewed US-Iran hostilities pushed Brent crude to about $97.50 a barrel, a seven-week high, dragging Asia-Pacific share markets lower on Tuesday.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊冲突再起，布伦特油价升至七周高位，亚太股市走低。
news.whyEn: Higher oil feeds directly into global inflation, keeps bond yields elevated and narrows the room for central banks to avoid further rate hikes.
news.whyZh: 油价上涨直接推高全球通胀，令债券收益率高企，压缩央行回避加息的空间。
news.detailEn: US and Iranian forces have traded strikes for months, and the latest flare-up again targeted shipping around the Strait of Hormuz, through which roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes. Brent rose more than 1% to around $97.50, its highest since mid-July, while the Australian share market fell about 0.5% with energy and mining stocks underperforming despite firmer commodity prices. Analysts say a lasting risk premium in oil would complicate the inflation picture just as the Federal Reserve and European Central Bank weigh rate decisions this month. Crude is still flowing and no major supply has been lost so far, but traders are pricing the risk of disruption. Markets are watching whether either side escalates toward a broader closure of the strait.
news.detailZh: 美伊两军已互袭数月，此轮升级再度瞄准霍尔木兹海峡周边航运，全球约五分之一海运石油经此通过。布伦特原油上涨逾1%至约97.5美元，创7月中旬以来新高；澳洲股市下跌约0.5%，能源和矿业股在商品价格走高的背景下仍表现落后。分析师称，若油价风险溢价持续，将令美联储和欧洲央行本月权衡利率决议时的通胀形势更趋复杂。目前原油仍在外运，尚无重大供应中断，但交易员已在为潜在扰动定价。市场关注任何一方是否会升级至更大范围封锁海峡。

news.titleEn: Global bond yields rising: Treasuries, JGBs and Bunds near multiyear highs
news.conclusionEn: A synchronized global bond sell-off has lifted the US 10-year Treasury yield to its highest since early 2025, Japan's 10-year near 3% (unseen since 1996) and Germany's to a 2011 high.
news.conclusionZh: 全球国债同步抛售，美债10年期收益率创2025年初来新高，日债逼近3%。
news.whyEn: Rising long-term yields raise borrowing costs for governments, companies and households worldwide and tighten financial conditions before central banks even act.
news.whyZh: 长端收益率走高会抬高全球政府、企业和家庭融资成本，在央行行动前就收紧金融环境。
news.detailEn: The move blends record government debt issuance, an oil-price shock that has revived inflation fears and expectations that central banks stay tighter for longer. Japan is especially exposed with debt above 200% of GDP, so higher rates sharply raise its debt-service bill, though analysts frame the Japanese move as normalization toward a higher-inflation regime rather than a crisis. Higher yields ripple into mortgages, corporate loans and emerging-market financing and pull money out of equities. The next test is US August inflation data due later this week, the last major reading before the Fed meets Sept. 15-16. A softer print could let yields retreat, while a hot one risks another leg higher.
news.detailZh: 本轮走势叠加了创纪录的政府债券发行、重燃通胀担忧的油价冲击，以及市场对央行更长时间维持紧缩的预期。日本尤其脆弱，其债务超过GDP的200%，利率上升会大幅推高偿债成本，不过分析师认为日债上行是向更高通胀常态的正常化，而非危机。收益率走高会传导至房贷、企业贷款和新兴市场融资，并促使资金撤出股市。下一个考验是本周晚些时候公布的美国8月通胀数据，这是美联储9月15至16日会议前最后的重要数据。数据偏软可能让收益率回落，偏热则有再度上行的风险。

news.titleEn: Fed rate-hike threat heats up as August inflation looms
news.conclusionEn: Fed officials including Governor Christopher Waller say the Sept. 15-16 rate decision hinges on August CPI, due Sept. 11, with futures pricing above a 60% chance of a hike.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储9月加息与否取决于9月11日的8月CPI，期货显示加息概率超60%。
news.whyEn: A rate hike into a slowing economy would be unusual and would push up Treasury yields, mortgage rates and global borrowing costs while pressuring equities.
news.whyZh: 在经济放缓时加息并不寻常，将推高美债收益率、房贷利率和全球融资成本，并施压股市。
news.detailEn: The Fed has held rates steady for five straight meetings, but hawkish signals from Chair Kevin Warsh and an oil-driven inflation scare have revived hike bets. Waller said he would back holding if inflation keeps easing toward 2%, but would consider a hike if it comes in hot. August payrolls rose 162,000, far above forecasts, giving the Fed more room to move. The Producer Price Index lands Sept. 10 and the Consumer Price Index Sept. 11, and traders see the CPI print as the pivotal factor for the decision. A hike would be the Fed's first move in either direction this year.
news.detailZh: 美联储已连续五次会议按兵不动，但主席沃什的鹰派表态和油价推动的通胀担忧重新点燃加息押注。沃勒表示，若通胀持续向2%回落他将支持不动，但若数据偏热则会考虑加息。8月非农新增16.2万人，远超预期，给美联储更多行动空间。9月10日公布PPI，9月11日公布CPI，交易员视CPI数据为决议的关键因素。若加息，将是美联储今年首次调整利率。

news.titleEn: ECB set to raise rates in September, but then done
news.conclusionEn: Economists expect the European Central Bank to lift its deposit rate a quarter point to 2.5% on Sept. 10, its second hike of 2026, to contain energy-driven inflation from the Iran war.
news.conclusionZh: 经济学家预计欧洲央行9月10日加息25基点至2.5%，为2026年第二次加息。
news.whyEn: It would make the ECB the most hawkish major central bank, raising borrowing costs across the euro zone and adding to the global upward move in yields.
news.whyZh: 此举将使欧洲央行成为最鹰派的主要央行，抬高欧元区借贷成本并加剧全球收益率上行。
news.detailEn: The ECB raised rates in June for the first time in nearly three years, paused in July, and is now expected to resume tightening as euro-zone headline inflation has climbed back above 3% on surging energy prices. Underlying pressures are milder, with core inflation near 2.4%, and most economists say the energy spike is unlikely to trigger broad second-round inflation. Policymakers are seen having little appetite to signal further hikes after September. National inflation rates diverge widely, from around 4.5% in Spain to below 3% in Germany. Markets will parse the ECB's updated forecasts for clues on the path into 2027.
news.detailZh: 欧洲央行6月近三年来首次加息，7月暂停，如今预计将恢复收紧，因能源价格飙升令欧元区整体通胀重回3%以上。基础价格压力较温和，核心通胀约2.4%，多数经济学家认为能源涨价不太可能引发广泛的第二轮通胀。市场普遍认为，9月之后决策者没有多少意愿再释放加息信号。各国通胀分化明显，从西班牙约4.5%到德国低于3%。市场将解读欧洲央行更新的预测，寻找2027年前政策路径的线索。

news.titleEn: Witkoff touts 'substantive progress' after peace talks with Ukraine, Russia
news.conclusionEn: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Zelensky in Kyiv on Sept. 7, a day after seeing Putin in Moscow, and reported progress toward scheduling trilateral talks to end the war.
news.conclusionZh: 美国特使会晤普京次日在基辅见泽连斯基，称推动三方谈判取得进展。
news.whyEn: It is the most concrete diplomatic push in months to end the Russia-Ukraine war, with implications for European security, energy prices and defense spending.
news.whyZh: 这是数月来推动结束俄乌战争最具体的外交行动，事关欧洲安全、能源价格与国防开支。
news.detailEn: National security advisers from the UK, Germany and France joined the Kyiv discussions, which covered Ukraine's air defenses, a winter energy support package and technological cooperation. Russia and Ukraine paused aerial attacks on each other's capitals over the weekend to allow the visits, though no broader ceasefire is in place. Moscow says it does not rule out a trilateral format but that it is too early to set a place or date. Zelensky wants to use September and October to revive diplomacy and has floated the UN General Assembly in New York as a venue. Putin is expected to weigh talks after Russia's Sept. 18-20 parliamentary elections.
news.detailZh: 英、德、法三国国家安全顾问参与了基辅会谈，议题包括乌克兰防空、过冬能源支持方案和技术合作。俄乌上周末暂停互相空袭对方首都以便访问成行，但尚无更广泛停火。莫斯科称不排除三方形式，但现在确定地点和时间为时尚早。泽连斯基希望利用9月和10月重启外交，并提出以纽约联合国大会为会谈场合。预计普京将在俄罗斯9月18至20日议会选举后再考虑谈判。

news.titleEn: Apple announces iPhone 18 Pro and foldable iPhone Ultra event: 'Surprise and shine'
news.conclusionEn: Apple holds its 'Surprise and shine' event on Sept. 9 in Cupertino, where new CEO John Ternus is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro line and Apple's first foldable iPhone.
news.conclusionZh: 苹果9月9日举行发布会，新任CEO预计发布iPhone 18 Pro和首款折叠屏iPhone。
news.whyEn: It is Apple's biggest hardware event in years and Ternus's first keynote as CEO, and the foldable is a test of whether Apple can reignite iPhone upgrade demand.
news.whyZh: 这是苹果多年来最重要的硬件发布会，也是新CEO首秀，折叠屏考验苹果能否重振换机需求。
news.detailEn: Apple is expected to show the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, a book-style foldable rumored to be called iPhone Ultra and priced above $2,000, plus the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4. The standard iPhone 18, 18e and an iPhone Air 2 are reportedly delayed to spring 2027, splitting Apple's annual launch for the first time. John Ternus took over from Tim Cook as CEO on Sept. 1 and will lead the presentation. Reported Pro upgrades include a variable-aperture main camera, a smaller Dynamic Island and Apple's in-house C2 modem. The event streams on Apple's site, YouTube and the Apple TV app at 10 a.m. Pacific.
news.detailZh: 苹果预计将展示iPhone 18 Pro和18 Pro Max、一款传闻名为iPhone Ultra、售价2000美元以上的书本式折叠屏手机，以及Apple Watch Series 12和Ultra 4。标准版iPhone 18、18e和iPhone Air 2据报道推迟至2027年春季，苹果首次拆分年度发布节奏。约翰·特努斯9月1日接替蒂姆·库克出任CEO，并将主持此次发布。Pro机型的升级据报道包括可变光圈主摄、更小的灵动岛和苹果自研C2基带。发布会将于太平洋时间上午10点在苹果官网、YouTube和Apple TV应用直播。

news.conclusionEn: Broadcom posted quarterly revenue of $29.4 billion, up 84% year on year, with AI chip revenue of about $16 billion (up more than 200%), and guided AI sales still higher.
news.conclusionZh: 博通季度营收294亿美元同比增84%，AI芯片收入约160亿美元增逾两倍。
news.whyEn: Broadcom is a bellwether for AI infrastructure demand, and its guidance shapes expectations for Nvidia, cloud capex and richly valued chip stocks.
news.whyZh: 博通是AI基础设施需求的风向标，其指引左右市场对英伟达和芯片股的预期。
news.detailEn: The company projected full fiscal 2026 AI semiconductor revenue of about $58 billion, up roughly 186%, and guided to $21.7 billion of AI chip sales in the current quarter. Management said it has a line of sight to $115 billion in AI chip revenue in fiscal 2027 and $230 billion in fiscal 2028, driven by custom accelerators it designs for customers reported to include Google, Meta and OpenAI. The results extend a run that has made Broadcom one of the biggest winners of the AI buildout. Investors are watching whether hyperscaler spending can sustain that trajectory. The stock has been among the top performers in large-cap tech this year.
news.detailZh: 公司预计2026整个财年的AI半导体收入约580亿美元，同比增长约186%，并指引本季度AI芯片销售额达217亿美元。管理层称，对2027财年1150亿美元、2028财年2300亿美元的AI芯片收入有明确预期，主要来自其为客户设计的定制加速器，据报道客户包括谷歌、Meta和OpenAI。这份业绩延续了让博通成为AI建设最大赢家之一的强劲走势。投资者关注超大规模云厂商的支出能否支撑这一增长轨迹。该股今年是大盘科技股中表现最好的之一。

news.conclusionEn: Gold traded around $4,491 an ounce in early September, near record highs and up more than 25% since early 2025 as inflation fears and central-bank buying persist.
news.conclusionZh: 9月初金价约每盎司4491美元，接近历史高位，2025年初以来涨逾25%。
news.whyEn: Record gold reflects deep unease about inflation, geopolitics and government debt, and signals investors and central banks seeking a hedge against currency and political risk.
news.whyZh: 金价创高反映市场对通胀、地缘政治和政府债务的深度不安，也是避险需求的信号。
news.detailEn: Gold has climbed through 2026 alongside an oil shock, sticky inflation and a global bond sell-off, with several forecasters lifting targets; JPMorgan has floated $6,300 by year-end. Central banks have kept buying at a near-record pace, and some, including the Dutch central bank, have repositioned reserves for faster access in a crisis. Higher bond yields would normally weigh on non-yielding gold, but safe-haven demand has more than offset that. Prices remain below the January 2026 intraday peak but well above year-ago levels. Traders are watching this week's US inflation data and the Fed meeting for the next catalyst.
news.detailZh: 2026年以来，金价在油价冲击、通胀黏性和全球国债抛售的背景下持续攀升，多家机构上调目标价，摩根大通提出年底见6300美元。各国央行仍以接近纪录的速度购金，其中荷兰央行等已调整储备布局以便危机时更快动用。收益率走高通常会压制不生息的黄金，但避险需求已足以抵消。当前价格低于2026年1月盘中高点，但远高于一年前水平。交易员正关注本周美国通胀数据和美联储会议这两个潜在催化剂。

news.titleEn: China exports likely slowed in August - Standard Chartered
news.conclusionEn: Economists expect China's August data this week to show export growth cooling on US tariffs and a fading front-loading effect, with consumer prices slipping back into deflation.
news.conclusionZh: 经济学家预计本周中国8月数据显示出口放缓、CPI重回通缩。
news.whyEn: As the world's second-largest economy and top exporter, weak Chinese demand and persistent deflation weigh on global growth, commodity prices and trading-partner economies.
news.whyZh: 作为全球第二大经济体和最大出口国，中国需求疲弱和持续通缩拖累全球增长与商品价格。
news.detailEn: Standard Chartered estimates export growth edged down in August as US reciprocal tariffs bite and an unfavorable base and slowing front-loading weigh, narrowing the monthly trade surplus to around $90 billion. Consumer prices are seen turning negative at about -0.3% year on year, partly on a high base, with food prices deflating more than 4.5%. Producer-price deflation is expected to ease on a low base. The figures would keep pressure on Beijing for more stimulus. Trade data is due first, followed by inflation readings later in the week.
news.detailZh: 渣打银行估计，8月出口增速小幅回落，因美国对等关税影响显现，加上基数不利和抢出口效应减弱，令单月贸易顺差收窄至约900亿美元。消费者价格预计同比转负至约-0.3%，部分因基数偏高，食品价格通缩超过4.5%。生产者价格通缩预计因低基数而缓解。这些数据将令北京面临更多刺激压力。贸易数据率先公布，通胀数据于本周稍后发布。

news.titleEn: Australian consumer sentiment slides under rates, petrol pressure
news.conclusionEn: The Westpac-Melbourne Institute consumer sentiment index fell 5.2% in September to 84.4, near two-year lows, as high fuel prices and fears of another RBA rate hike hit households.
news.conclusionZh: 9月西太-墨尔本消费者信心指数跌5.2%至84.4，油价与加息担忧打压情绪。
news.whyEn: Australia's economy leans heavily on consumer spending and construction, so weak confidence and a cooling housing market raise the risk of a sharper slowdown.
news.whyZh: 澳洲经济高度依赖消费和建筑业，信心疲弱加上楼市降温，加大经济加速放缓的风险。
news.detailEn: The survey, taken after July data showed core inflation above forecast, reflects speculation the Reserve Bank of Australia may raise rates a fourth time this year. Mortgage holders' sentiment dropped about 13%, and petrol above A$2 a litre compounded the gloom. Separately, HSBC has warned of a peak-to-trough house price fall of around 13%, which would be the largest in three decades, and the collapse of developer Bathla Group has exposed strains in private credit funding for construction. Multiple job-holding has hit a record 6.9% as households chase income. The RBA's next decision is later in September.
news.detailZh: 该调查在7月核心通胀高于预期的数据公布后进行，反映市场猜测澳洲联储今年可能第四次加息。房贷持有者的信心下降约13%，油价突破每升2澳元加剧悲观情绪。另外，汇丰警告房价从峰值到谷底可能下跌约13%，将是三十年来最大跌幅，开发商Bathla集团的倒闭则暴露了建筑业私募信贷融资的紧张。为增加收入，身兼多职的比例升至6.9%的纪录高位。澳洲联储下次决议在9月晚些时候。

businessTips.explanationEn: Unit economics is the profit or loss a business makes on a single unit of what it sells - one customer, one order, one subscription. The core measures are contribution margin (revenue per unit minus the variable costs to deliver it) and, for recurring businesses, customer lifetime value (LTV) versus customer acquisition cost (CAC). If a company loses money on every unit, growth only deepens the hole; if each unit is comfortably profitable, scaling makes sense. Operators and investors use unit economics to judge whether a business model actually works before worrying about total revenue.
businessTips.explanationZh: 单位经济效益是指企业在其所售的单个单位上——一位客户、一笔订单、一份订阅——赚取的利润或亏损。核心指标是边际贡献（单位收入减去交付它的可变成本），以及对订阅类业务而言的客户终身价值（LTV）与获客成本（CAC）之比。如果公司在每个单位上都亏钱，增长只会让窟窿更大；如果每个单位都能稳定盈利，扩张才有意义。经营者和投资者用单位经济效益来判断商业模式是否真的成立，然后才关心总营收。
businessTips.exampleEn: A meal-kit startup sells a box for $60 that costs $38 in food, packaging and delivery, leaving a $22 contribution margin. If it spends $90 on ads to win a customer who stays for six boxes, LTV is about $132 against a $90 CAC - workable. If that customer only buys twice, LTV drops to $44 and every new customer loses money.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家净菜配送创业公司以60美元卖出一盒，食材、包装和配送成本为38美元，边际贡献为22美元。如果它花90美元广告费获得一位会购买六盒的客户，终身价值约132美元，对应90美元获客成本——可行。如果该客户只买两次，终身价值降至44美元，每获得一位新客户都在亏钱。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pre-selling means taking real orders or paid deposits for a product before you have built it. It replaces guesswork about demand with hard evidence: people either pay or they don't. It also funds production with customers' money instead of your savings, and feedback from early buyers shapes what you actually build. The main obligations are to be honest about timelines and to refund promptly if you fail to deliver.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预售是指在产品还没做出来之前，就接受真实订单或收取付费定金。它用确凿证据取代对需求的猜测：人们要么付钱，要么不付。它还用客户的钱而非你的积蓄来支持生产，早期买家的反馈也会塑造你真正要做的东西。主要的义务是如实说明交付时间，以及万一无法交付要及时退款。
businessTips.exampleEn: A woodworker wants to launch a line of desk organizers. Instead of building 200 units upfront, she posts three photos and a $45 pre-order price with shipping in eight weeks. Forty orders come in, covering material costs and confirming the design; a fourth variant that gets no orders is quietly dropped.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位木工想推出一系列桌面收纳件。她没有先做200件，而是发布三张照片和45美元的预购价，承诺八周内发货。收到40笔订单，覆盖了材料成本并验证了设计；一款无人下单的第四种款式则悄悄取消。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging (DCA) is investing a fixed amount at regular intervals - say monthly - regardless of price, rather than trying to time a lump-sum entry. Because the fixed sum buys more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high, it smooths your average purchase price and removes the pressure to predict market tops and bottoms. The trade-off is that in a market that mostly rises, investing a lump sum earlier would often have earned more. DCA is mainly a discipline and risk-management tool for volatile markets and for people investing from each paycheck.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（DCA）是指不论价格高低，按固定金额、固定间隔（比如每月）投资，而不是试图择时一次性入场。由于固定金额在低价时买入更多份额、高价时买入更少，它会平滑你的平均买入成本，并免去预测市场顶部和底部的压力。代价是，在多数时间上涨的市场里，更早一次性投入往往收益更高。定投主要是一种纪律和风险管理工具，适合波动市场以及用每份工资进行投资的人。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor puts $500 into a broad index fund on the first of every month. In a volatile stretch the fund trades at $50, then $40, then $45: the three contributions buy 10, 12.5 and 11.1 shares, for an average cost of about $44.7 - below the simple average price of $45. She never has to decide whether 'now' is a good time to buy.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者每月1号向一只宽基指数基金投入500美元。在一段波动行情中，基金价格依次为50、40、45美元：三次投入分别买到10、12.5和11.1份，平均成本约44.7美元，低于45美元的简单均价。她无需判断「现在」是不是买入的好时机。
